summary: Precision BioSciences filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing clinical rather than transactional developments. It furnished a press release updating the ELIMINATE-B Phase 1 trial of PBGENE-HBV for chronic hepatitis B, the published AASLD late-breaker abstract, and a second release noting the first PBGENE-DMD patient completed eight weeks post-treatment with no safety concerns and DSMB endorsement to continue FUNCTION-DMD Part 1 dosing. An updated corporate deck was furnished, with a webcast set for November 9, 2026. No deal terms, ownership changes or strategic events are stated; no risk-arb angle applies.
